string.name: MainAbility_desc
string.value: Herramientas para tu reloj: baterías, lugares, koala, metro y más

string.name: reason_vibrate
string.value: Vibration for taps, timers and alerts.

string.name: reason_location
string.value: Places: save spots and show distance and direction to them. Bike mode: measure your speed. Used only while the screen is open; the location never leaves the watch.

string.name: reason_activity
string.value: Counts your steps to feed the Koala pet. Steps are stored only on the watch.

string.name: reason_health
string.value: Shows your live heart-rate zone in Bike mode. Heart rate is not stored.

string.name: reason_accel
string.value: Detects a wrist shake gesture. Motion data is not stored.
